summary: Enable Bill Voiding for Abandoned Visits
description:
Allow administrators to void unpaid bills for abandoned visits to maintain accurate billing records and reporting.
User Story:
As an administrator, I want to be able to void bills for abandoned visits, so that unpaid bills from incomplete visits don't clutter the billing system.

Functional Requirements:
Void Eligibility: 
VOID action is only available for bills with zero payments recorded

Bills with any payment amount (partial or full) cannot be voided

Only users with the Administrator role can void bills


Void Workflow:
User selects the VOID action on the eligible bill

System prompts for a mandatory reason for voiding, for example, Patient abandoned visit, Patient refused service before paying, Billing error, Other reasons

User enters reason

System confirms void action

Upon confirmation:
Bill status updates from PENDING to CANCELLED

Void reason and timestamp recorded



Bill Status Updates:
PENDING → After Void: CANCELLED

Cancelled bills remain in the system for audit purposes

Cancelled bills are excluded from outstanding payment reports
